description: This is a 3D model of a patio umbrella with a built-in table. The umbrella features a large, octagonal canopy in a muted brown color, supported by a silver metal frame with numerous radiating spokes. The canopy edges are scalloped, giving it a classic umbrella shape. Below the canopy, a round, wooden table is attached to the central pole. The table has a natural wood grain texture and a simple, flat surface. The pole is made of silver metal and is anchored by a hexagonal, textured base, likely designed to provide stability. The overall impression is one of outdoor furniture designed for relaxation or dining in a patio or garden setting.
